verdict.rationale: Zamzar documents broad document conversion: over 1,100 conversions across hundreds of formats, including documents (zamzar-docs-11). Its API example converts a file to PDF (zamzar-docs-3). However, nothing in the pack names Word, Excel, or PowerPoint formats specifically, or conversion between office formats. missing for 10: explicit DOCX/XLSX/PPTX-to-PDF support, documented conversion between office formats (e.g. DOC↔DOCX, XLSX↔ODS, PPTX↔ODP), independent or hands-on corroboration of office conversion quality.
